assessment: The error fired 40.517 ms after page.goto replaced the project document and before the article navigation completed. The failing RSC request has no completed HAR snapshot, while neighboring same-origin prefetches completed with HTTP 200. This supports cancellation during artificial document replacement, rather than a product CSP, redirect, or server response failure. The harness now waits for project-page prefetch activity to become idle before replacing that document; it does not filter page errors.
